audit.whatIsWrong: Marked EVEN at 6/10 while the win rate is 54.89% over 1115 games and the mirror set this lane HARD 7/10 from Graves's side.
audit.why: Quinn out-trades him from level 1 to 5; only levels 6 and the first-item window belong to Graves. That is a favoured lane, not an even one.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN -> FAV, diffRating 6/10 -> 3/10 (inverse of the mirror's 7/10), tone moved to the favoured colour, and the two prose difficulty lines updated to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill/Quinn/Quinn/Skill/Skill/Quinn/Quinn; packet and mirror both read Quinn/Quinn/Quinn/Quinn/Graves/Graves/Quinn.
audit.why: Graves has no answer before Quickdraw, and once Collateral Damage and True Grit stacks arrive he survives the all-in — his window is levels 6 through first item, then Quinn scales back ahead.
audit.corrected: All seven rows and all seven ratings proposed as one atomic group across both layers, ratings inverse to the mirror's 3,3,3,3,6,6,3. Real numbers added: Quickdraw 16s at rank 1, Smoke Screen 26s, End of the Line 13s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five strings say Blinding Assault blinds his shotgun blast; wants.foe[0] credits Vault with a knockback; wants.foe[1] calls Smoke Screen a blind.
audit.why: Riot's Blinding Assault text is a mark that hinders vision — it does not make his attacks miss. Vault lands Quinn at her own maximum attack range; nothing is pushed. Smoke Screen's own text reduces sight range and slows on impact — it too is vision denial, not an accuracy debuff. Quickdraw's cooldown is also refunded by his basic attacks, so a flat 'wait it out' is wrong.
audit.corrected: Restated all three as vision denial or repositioning, and noted the Quickdraw refund so the wait-it-out advice is honest.

edits.before: Passive-mark AA trades win every short exchange. Identify how Graves contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Your range and Harrier auto-resets out-trade his two shotgun shells at 1, before Quickdraw exists to reposition him.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Quickdraw's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Keep converting the trade lead into plates while Quickdraw (16s at rank 1) and Smoke Screen (26s) are still recharging.

edits.before: Behind Enemy Lines exports your lead — roam on every shove. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Graves's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Collateral Damage plus stacking True Grit lets him survive your all-in and shove you off the wave — roam with R instead.

edits.before: Youmuu's Ghostblade is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Quickdraw's cooldown.
edits.after: His Eclipse/IE shotgun crits out-trade your squishy frame on his first item — kite it, do not duel.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Graves carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in, your range reclaims the kite — you outscale a tank-built Graves if you stayed ahead. Close it out.

edits.before: Track Graves's Quickdraw: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Blind + vault re-kite.
edits.after: Quickdraw is 16s at rank 1, but his autos refund it. Smoke Screen cuts sight range, not your damage — step out, then trade.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Quickdraw and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 3/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Quickdraw, 16s at rank 1 and refunded by his autos.

edits.before: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Graves carry threat 8/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 3/10, Graves carry threat 8/10.

edits.before: Land Q to blind his shotgun blast so his burst whiffs while your Harrier autos land
edits.after: Land Blinding Assault to hinder his vision so he loses you while your Harrier autos land

edits.before: Use E dash to reposition out of your Vault knockback and reset his shotgun spacing
edits.after: Use Quickdraw to reset shotgun spacing after Vault drops you back to attack range

edits.before: Drop W smoke to blind your Harrier autos and break your trade burst
edits.after: Drop Smoke Screen to cut your sight range and slow you out of the trade

notes: The full layer still labels Quinn's E as 'Vault (Dash/Blind)' in several template strings the mirror also could not reach — Vault has no blind. Those need a manual sweep. Graves's passive fires four bullets that cannot pass through units, which is a real minion-block interaction for his poke, but nothing in the kits states how it behaves against a champion behind minions, so I did not write it.
